summary.result: Statistical analysis indicated that all results using the both of models are significant at a 95 % confidence level.
summary.background: Many models have been used to represent the effects of confining stress, bulk stress, and shear stress on the value of the resilient modulus (Mr).
summary.method: The first model (A-model) can provide a quick and easy estimation of the Mr based on the bulk stress, while the second model (N-model) includes not only the bulk stress but also the shear stress.
